descriptionPlain: Zeta, a banking technology company, is hiring a Cloud Network Engineer II in Hyderabad, India (onsite) for its Global SRE team.

lists.content:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or IT
  • 2-3 years in Cloud Networking, Infrastructure Automation or DevOps
  • Hands-on AWS (mandatory), Linux and Terraform
  • Kubernetes experience
  • Python or Bash scripting for automation
  • Cloud networking: DNS, load balancers, VPC, security groups
  • CI/CD, Git, Helm
